name: Log Shattering of Warmuth's $C_5$ Class
proof: The empty set, every one-coordinate set, and every two-coordinate set are shattered, giving $1+5+\binom52=16$ shattered sets.  No three-coordinate set is shattered because the VC dimension is two.  The binary logarithm of the number of shattered sets is therefore $\log_2 16=4$.
